work.author: Church of England
work.description: The prayer book of the Church of England. Its Sunday collects, epistles and gospels inherit the Sarum arrangement, which is why it stands in this collection at all: its Seventeenth Sunday after Trinity carries the collect of the Roman Sixteenth Sunday after Pentecost.
